notes.title: Kinoko Soundtrack News!
notes.content:
Hello! We're happy to announce an update to the Kinoko Soundtrack - the beautiful music of Kinoko is now available in super high quality. We've updated the soundtrack on its Steam page, you can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1360060/Kinoko_Soundtrack/]here[/url]!

And if that's not enough, the music of Kinoko is now also available on all major music streaming platforms! Grab some headphones and let yourself be carried away into Kinokos serene, relaxing world - we hope you enjoy it.
